jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship/scholarship - Integration of view-out quality and privacy assessment in building design activities
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
Integration of view-out quality and privacy assessment in building design activities

Research area and project description:
The aim of this Ph.D. project is to develop methods for designing facades and surrounding landscapes with a regenerative environmental impact under future climate scenarios. The objective is to develop a model that predicts occupants’ satisfaction with view-out quality and visual privacy for different combinations of façade and landscape design, and to integrate it into existing indoor environmental quality (IEQ) models. Combined with assessments of material use and life-cycle environmental impacts, the model will help designers identify solutions that offer the best trade-offs between maximising occupant satisfaction and minimising the material demand and environmental impacts of the building and landscape elements. The hypothesis is that façade and landscape designs which achieve higher occupant satisfaction with both view-out quality and visual privacy are less likely to be altered in response to dissatisfaction with either aspect. This resilience is expected to extend the functional longevity of the original design and reduce the additional material use and environmental impacts associated with such alterations.

The methodological approach to establish the model will be a combination of user perception experiments on the perception of view quality and visual privacy through windows in facade systems in both lab experiments and field studies. Co-creation techniques are applied to engage with the building industry to integrate and test the model in practical design methods and workflows for climate-resilient design of buildings under future climate scenarios.
The background for the project is that the planetary boundaries are overstepped due to excessive environmental load from human activities, which means that humanity has entered a zone of risk of deleterious or even catastrophic environmental change at continental to global scales. The main driver for this is the built environment that e.g. accounts for approx. 43% of all energy-related CO2-emissions. There is therefore an acute need to reduce the environmental load from the built environment to a level that enables the regenerative properties of the planetary ecosystems to reestablish the safe operating space below the planetary boundaries.

Qualifications and specific competences:
The candidate must have an M.Sc. degree or similar in architectural engineering. Applicants are expected to have at least five years of experience from building design practice. Documented experience in digital building modelling and practical experience in user involvement processes is mandatory. Experience with evaluation of view-out quality and privacy in design practice is preferred.

Place of employment and place of work:
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Inge Lehmanns Gade 10, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Contacts:
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
 
• Professor Steffen Petersen, e-mail: stp@cae.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Assistant Professor Pil Brix Purup (Tenure-Track), e-mail: Pil@cae.au.dk (co-supervisor)
 For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
 
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
 How to apply:
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 8 December 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 1 February 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
 Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

jobs.occupation: Lastbilchauffør (C/CE) / Truck Driver (C/CE)– Stabrand Spedition, Nordhavn
jobs.description:
Lastbilchauffører søges til Stabrand Spedition i Nordhavn

Vi søger flere lastbilchauffører til vores kørselsafdeling med udgangspunkt fra Skagerrakvej 8, 2150 Nordhavn.

Hos Stabrand Spedition får du en hverdag, hvor dagene ikke nødvendigvis ligner hinanden. Vi kører både stykgods, part loads, full loads samt skibscontainere på chassis og med sideloader, primært på Sjælland.

Du får som udgangspunkt fast tilknyttet bil, som du har ansvar for i det daglige. Du bliver samtidig en del af et godt chaufførteam, hvor man hjælper hinanden, taler ordentligt sammen og har tæt kontakt med vores disponenter.

Arbejdsdagen

Arbejdsdagen starter normalt omkring kl. 06.00-06.30 i Nordhavn.

Opgaverne varierer efter, hvad der skal køres den pågældende dag. Det kan være stykgods den ene dag, part- eller full load den næste og containerkørsel en tredje.

Derudover følger de almindelige chaufføropgaver selvfølgelig med: af- og pålæsning, lastsikring, håndtering af trailer og containere, dokumenter samt almindelig kontrol og pasning af bilen og udstyret.

Vi leder efter dig, der er mødestabil, tager ansvar for dit arbejde og kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du skal passe ordentligt på bilen og materiellet og være indstillet på, at planen nogle gange ændrer sig i løbet af dagen.

Som chauffør er du ofte den person fra Stabrand Spedition, som vores kunder møder. Derfor betyder det også noget for os, at du er ordentlig i din omgang med kunderne og repræsenterer virksomheden på en god måde.

Engelsk er et krav. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke nødvendigt.

Har du erfaring med containerkørsel, stykgods eller anden godskørsel, er det selvfølgelig en fordel.

Kørekort og certifikater

Når du søger, vil vi gerne have et klart overblik over, hvad du har af kørekort og beviser.

·   dine kørekortkategorier og udløbsdato

·   eventuelt chaufføruddannelsesbevis / EU-kvalifikationsbevis og udløbsdato

·   førerkort til digital takograf og udløbsdato

·   eventuelt ADR-bevis

·   eventuelt krancertifikat

·   andre relevante certifikater eller uddannelser

ADR og krancertifikat er en fordel, men ikke et krav til alle vores opgaver.

Hvad får du hos os?

Du får en fuldtidsstilling med udgangspunkt i Nordhavn, primært kørsel på Sjælland, forskellige typer transportopgaver og en fast tilknyttet bil.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor transport hænger tæt sammen med vores terminal-, lager- og 3PL-aktiviteter. Det giver en hverdag med mange forskellige typer opgaver og korte veje mellem chauffører, disponenter og resten af organisationen.

Ansøgning

Send os en kort ansøgning eller præsentation af dig selv sammen med dit CV på tobias@stabrand.dk eller ring på 39209030 for spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen.

Husk at angive dine kørekortkategorier, udløbsdatoer og relevante certifikater.

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale.

***ENGLISH BELOW***

Truck Drivers Wanted for Stabrand Spedition in Nordhavn

We are looking for additional truck drivers to join our transport department, based at Skagerrakvej 8, 2150 Nordhavn.

At Stabrand Spedition, no two days are necessarily the same. We handle groupage, part loads, full loads and shipping containers on chassis and sideloaders, mainly across Zealand.

As a general rule, you will have a truck assigned to you and be responsible for it in your day-to-day work. You will also join a good team of drivers where people help each other, communicate properly and work closely with our dispatchers.

The working day

The working day normally starts around 06:00-06:30 in Nordhavn.

The jobs vary depending on what needs to be transported that day. One day may involve groupage, the next a part or full load, and another day container transport.

The usual driver duties are naturally part of the job as well: loading and unloading, securing cargo, handling trailers and containers, paperwork, and normal daily checks and care of the truck and equipment.

We are looking for someone who turns up on time, takes responsibility for the job and is comfortable working independently. You should take good care of the truck and equipment and be prepared for plans to change during the day from time to time.

As a driver, you are often the person from Stabrand Spedition our customers meet. It therefore matters to us that you deal with customers properly and represent the company in a professional and positive way.

English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience with container transport, groupage or other types of goods transport is an advantage.

Driving licence and certificates

When applying, please give us a clear overview of your driving licence and certificates.

·   your driving licence categories and expiry date

·   any driver qualification card / EU Certificate of Professional Competence and expiry date

·   digital tachograph driver card and expiry date

·   any ADR certificate

·   any crane certificate

·   other relevant certificates or qualifications

ADR and crane certificates are an advantage, but they are not required for all of our assignments.

What we offer

This is a full-time position based in Nordhavn, with driving mainly across Zealand, a varied mix of transport assignments and, a truck assigned to you only.

You will join a company where transport works closely together with our terminal, warehouse and 3PL activities. This creates a varied working day and short lines of communication between drivers, dispatchers and the rest of the organisation.

Application

Send us a short application or introduction together with your CV to tobias@stabrand.dk or contact us via +45 39209030 for questions regarding the position.

Please remember to include your driving licence categories, expiry dates and relevant certificates.

We invite suitable candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics | Successful International Group
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a successful international distributor of specialty chemicals, with operations across a number of international markets and a presence in more than 20 countries.

The group holds a strong international position and is currently working to strengthen its presence and drive further growth in the Nordics and Baltics.

You will become a pivotal part of an international organization, with excellent opportunities to influence development and shape the direction of future commercial growth.

About the Position

As Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics, you will have overall responsibility for the business unit's development, performance, and future direction in the region.

Your primary task will be to set the strategic direction and ensure the continuous development of the business. You will play a central role in translating the group's ambitions into concrete goals and results, as well as creating the organizational and commercial framework for future growth.

In close collaboration with the Sales Director, you will develop and implement the strategy for the region and ensure progress through clear leadership, prioritization, and strong cooperation with the rest of the organization.

You will establish direction and engagement within the organization, develop leaders and employees, and ensure that the right competencies and resources are brought into play. The role requires the ability to deliver results through others while maintaining a strategic overview and an understanding of the business's commercial opportunities.

Your Primary Responsibilities

• Develop leaders and employees with a focus on competencies, engagement, accountability, and collaboration.

• Translate the group's overall ambitions into concrete strategies, goals, and action plans.

• Support a company culture characterized by initiative, ownership, openness, and continuous development.

About You

You have leadership experience and a strong strategic understanding. You possess the ability to gain commitment, set direction, and develop an organization through clear leadership, involvement, and trust.

You do not necessarily need to have held a director-level position previously. The most important thing is that you have the ambition, the strategic overview, and the ability to take overall responsibility for a business unit's development and results.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience in commercial leadership and organizational development, including developing and implementing strategies and translating them into concrete goals and results.

• Are a clear leader who sets direction, builds engagement, and ensures progress.

• Thrive with overall responsibility and are able to maintain both the strategic overview and an understanding of the organization's daily operations.

• Are a modern leader who believes in freedom with responsibility and is motivated by coaching and facilitating rather than micromanaging.

• Have experience in developing people and achieving results through others.

• Possess a good financial understanding and the ability to make decisions on a sound strategic and financial basis.

• Have experience from the specialty chemicals industry or related sectors. This will be considered an advantage.

• Communicate effortlessly in both Danish and English. Additional language skills are an advantage.

What Is Offered

• A central leadership position with responsibility for an international business unit that is part of a successful global group.

• A commercial mandate with the opportunity to influence strategy and organization and leave a clear mark on the development of the Nordics and Baltics.

• A dynamic working environment combining strategic responsibility, leadership, and organizational development.

• Business travel in connection with the development of the business in the Nordics and Baltics, with significant influence over your own travel planning.

Workplace: Aarhus area.

You can be based anywhere in Denmark, as there are good opportunities for remote work. If you live outside daily commuting distance, you will be expected to work from the office approximately once a week.

Application

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to upload your CV as soon as possible.

Please upload your CV and, optionally, a short cover letter using the Apply for the Position button.

The job advertisement will be removed once the position has been filled.

All inquiries and applications will, of course, be treated confidentially.

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer, Automation & Machine Control
jobs.description:
At Struers, we help companies and laboratories around the world understand their materials and make confident decisions about quality. Our purpose is Ensuring Certainty, and behind the equipment that delivers that certainty is increasingly sophisticated software.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to help develop the machine-control software behind our next generation of products.

Our machine-control platform is based on modern PLC technology, but this is not a traditional PLC programming role. We approach machine control as a software engineering discipline, applying principles such as structured architecture, modularity, reuse, design patterns, automated testing, and maintainable code.

Whether your background is embedded software, automation, control engineering, C/C++, C#, or PLC development, we are interested in strong software engineers who enjoy making software interact with the physical world.

You will contribute from early concepts through product launch, developing reusable software components, machine behavior, and control algorithms, and validating your solutions directly on real machines.

Key Responsibilities:

• Implement machine control and process logic for Struers machines.

• Design control algorithms and implement software designs based on input from software architects.

• Develop and improve reusable software modules and libraries for Struers machines.

• Apply modern software engineering principles to create robust, modular, testable, and maintainable machine software.

• Test and verify software directly on real machines and equipment.

• Work closely with mechanical, hardware, and project teams.

• Participate in R&D product projects from concept phase to product launch.

• Contribute to code reviews and analysis of other developers’ work.

• Establish required design, test, and product documentation.

• Support handover of product software and documentation to the engineering department responsible for product and platform maintenance.

• Collaborate with international software colleagues, including the Czech software team.

• Demonstrate the ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and cost efficiency.

• Identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

Requirements:

Education & Experience:

Must-have:

• Relevant engineering degree or similar technical background.

• Hands-on software development experience.

• Ability to develop structured and maintainable software.

• Experience from at least one relevant software development technology, for example, C/C++, C#, Java, PLC programming, or another structured or object-oriented programming language.

• Interest in automation, machine control, PLC-based systems, embedded software, or industrial software development.

• Ability and motivation to work with physical equipment and test software on real machines.

• Good communication skills in English, both spoken and written.

Nice-to-have:

• Experience with machine control, process logic, automation systems, or control/regulation.

• Experience with object-oriented programming.

• Experience with Structured Text or PLC programming.

• Experience designing or implementing control algorithms.

• Experience from industrial equipment, machinery, production equipment, or similar domains.

• Experience working in international engineering teams.

Professional skills:

• Structured and analytical approach to software development.

• Ability to understand software designs and implement them in a maintainable way.

• Ability to work close to physical products and solve practical engineering problems.

• Strong collaboration skills across software, hardware, mechanical, and project disciplines.

• Ability to take responsibility for implementation tasks within product projects.

• Interest in building robust, reusable, and maintainable software solutions.

• Good communication skills and ability to contribute positively in an international team.

• Self-motivated and focused on moving tasks toward completion.

• Curious and willing to learn Struers’ products, domain, platform, and development practices.

Success Criteria:

• High-quality machine-control software is delivered according to project needs and the agreed software architecture.

• Machine control and process logic are implemented in a structured, maintainable, and reusable way.

• Software is tested and verified systematically on real machines and equipment.

• Reusable software modules and libraries contribute to reduced development time across projects.

• Software design and implementation meet relevant quality, maintainability, cost, and compliance expectations.

• The role contributes positively to collaboration between software, mechanical, hardware, and project teams.

• The role contributes to effective collaboration across locations, including with the Czech software team.

• Product software and documentation are handed over in a structured way to the engineering department responsible for product and platform maintenance.

About the Business Unit

Struers is an AMETEK business unit and a global leader in materialographic and metallographic solutions, providing equipment, consumables, software, and services for material testing, sample preparation, and hardness testing. Its technologies help manufacturers, research institutions, and laboratories analyze materials and ensure the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance across industries such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, energy, and advanced manufacturing.

Founded in 1875 in Denmark and headquartered in Ballerup, Denmark, Struers has more than 150 years of expertise in material science and a global presence with offices and support teams worldwide. Known for its strong application knowledge, innovation, and customer-focused approach, Struers helps organizations achieve accurate and reproducible material analysis results that support product development, quality control, and scientific advancement.

For more information, visit www.ametek.com/ and www.struers.com/en

Compensation

Currency: DKK

Salary Minimum: 60,000

Salary Maximum: 65,000

Incentive: No

Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.

AMETEK, Inc. is a leading global provider of industrial technology solutions serving a diverse set of attractive niche markets with annual sales over $7.5 billion.

AMETEK is committed to making a safer, sustainable, and more productive world a reality. We use differentiated technology solutions to solve our customers’ most complex challenges. We employ 22,000 colleagues, in 35 countries, that are grounded by our core values: Ethics and Integrity, Respect for the Individual, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Social Responsibility. AMETEK is a component of the S&P 500. Visit https://www.ametek.com/careers for more information.

jobs.occupation: Engineering manager
jobs.description:
About Be My Eyes

Be My Eyes is on a mission to make the world more accessible for the 340 million people who are blind or have low vision. Our apps connect people with volunteers, companies and AI through live video, free of charge, so they can handle the inaccessible parts of everyday life at home and at work.

The idea came from Hans Jørgen Wiberg, a Danish craftsman with low vision. The app launched in 2015, drew 10,000 volunteer sign-ups in its first 24 hours, and now has millions of volunteers helping in more than 180 languages. Today our products include the Be My Eyes app, Be My AI, Be My Eyes for Smart Glasses, the Service Directory and Be My Eyes for Desktop.

We build products with our community, not just for it, and their needs come first even when that challenges our own assumptions. We move fast, care about the details and take ownership of what we ship. We see mistakes as part of pushing boundaries, and we take kindness seriously while keeping room for fun.

Read more about our story

About the role

You'll own the "how" of product development. The role sits where engineering leadership meets hands-on technical work: you'll lead engineers across mobile, web and backend, and stay close enough to the code to make real technical calls.

You'll partner closely with Product and Design to ship software that blind and low vision users depend on daily. You'll also grow the people on your team, so they leave each year stronger engineers than they started it.

Small team, global impact

Few places let you work on a small team and still reach millions of people. Our whole product and engineering team is about 12 people. What we ship directly shapes the quality of life of blind and low vision people around the world.

We're also working to reach the rest of the 340 million people who are blind or have low vision, wherever they live and whatever device they use. Our tools are free for the people who rely on them. We build them to improve lives, not to make a quick profit.

For your career, that means rare scope. Your decisions reach real people fast, and you'll see the difference your team makes.

What you'll do

• 
Set technical direction, and give the team ground-up context on how product decisions shape implementation

• 
Manage and develop a team of 5–6 engineers across iOS, Android, web and operations

• 
Be the technical fix-it person when problems fall through the cracks

• 
Partner with the CTO, VP of Product and Head of Design to plan and deliver work

• 
Drive engineering quality across AI-powered features, mobile apps and infrastructure

• 
Keep projects moving across competing priorities, without losing sight of what matters to our users

What we're looking for

• 
4+ years in software engineering and engineering leadership

• 
Strong enough technically to read code, make architectural calls and unblock engineers

• 
A track record of developing engineers — coaching them and growing their careers, not just managing their work

• 
Comfort with ambiguity and competing priorities

• 
Real care about accessibility and about building with the people who use what you ship

Nice to have

• 
Lived experience as a blind or low vision person

• 
Experience shipping iOS or Android apps that work well with VoiceOver or TalkBack

• 
Experience building or running AI- or LLM-powered product features

• 
Hands-on time with Python/Django, React or Kubernetes

• 
Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG

Open to everyone

We welcome applicants of every age, gender and ability. If you don't tick every box above but the role excites you, we'd still like to hear from you.

Lived experience as a blind or low vision person is a real strength on our team. It brings first-hand insight into how our products work in daily life, which leads to better decisions about what we build and how.

If you need adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, tell us and we'll arrange them.

For more information or questions please contact us at rasmus@bemyeyes.com

Perks and benefits

This job comes with several perks and benefits

Pension plan

Pension plan

Equity package

Equity package

Remote work allowed

Remote work allowed

Maternity / paternity leave

Maternity / paternity leave

Paid holiday

Paid holiday

Work life balance

Work life balance

See all 7 benefits

Working at

Be My Eyes

See company profile

Be My Eyes is a unique, venture-funded, profit-with-purpose company that connects blind and low-vision people needing sighted support with volunteers and companies through live video calls. With a nearly 90% successful call rate, our volunteers assist the blind with daily tasks as simple as finding something in the kitchen to something as complex as navigating an airport. Operating in 150 countries and 60 languages, Be My Eyes is the largest digital volunteering community in the world with over 6,1 million volunteers and 450.000 blind and low-vision users. We're also a proud winner of an Apple Design Award for our app. We offer a suite of enterprise products including: • Specialized Help: an add on to your existing customer call center enabling video calls to better serve your blind and low-vision customers • Corporate Volunteering: we can have your whole team or entire company receive a call to assist a blind person providing a lesson in accessibility and meaningful volunteer service. Most companies do this as part of a team meeting, onsite or offsite, and based on our customers feedback, a great deal of joy for you and your teams. • Platinum Partnership: We will partner with the biggest brands in the world who will have the opportunity to send a “thank you” note and/or discounted products and services to our volunteers via a push notification right after they successfully complete a call. • Artificial Intelligence: Be My Eyes also possesses unique and highly valuable A.I. training assets that several of the leading experts in the world have told us would significantly accelerate most company roadmaps not only on accessibility products, but also in areas like advanced robotics, and a host of other machine learning applications. With customers like Microsoft, Google, Procter & Gamble, Verizon, Sony, Instacart, Snowflake and many others, we have a chance to dent the universe through a business model that creates simultaneous delight for our blind and low-vision community, our volunteers, and the companies utilizing our platform.

Read more about Be My Eyes

jobs.occupation: Part-time Lecturers in International Business or Business & Government | CBS - Copenhagen Business School
jobs.description:
A number of positions as Part-time Lecturers in International Business and Business & Government respectively are available at the Department of International Economics, Government and Business (EGB) for appointment as soon as possible.

EGB is a multidisciplinary department, which conducts high-quality research in the fields of international business and political science with direct relevance to business, decision-makers and the broader public.

The department delivers research-based teaching into undergraduate and graduate teaching in programs such as International Business, International Business and Politics, and International Business in Asia. To learn more about the research and teaching activities of the department, please visit the departmental website here

As part-time lecturer you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to educate young people and to provide them with insight into your practical experience. At CBS part-time lecturers represent an important supplement to the teaching done by researchers. Your role as part-time lecturer will also provide you with opportunities to update your theoretical knowledge, to share in discussions with ambitious students and to be part of an international academic environment.

The position is on a temporary (3 years) part-time basis, which can be extended within the framework of the Danish Fixed-Term Employment Act (Lov om tidsbegrænset ansættelse).

The position may include

• Planning and conducting teaching in Business & Government

• Planning and conducting teaching in Strategies of Multinational Corporations and Risk management

• Planning and conducting teaching in Policy-making

• Planning and conducting teaching in Political Science with an emphasis on Comparative Politics

• Online teaching—blended learning

• Student supervision

• Preparing teaching materials and exam questions

• Conducting exams and other evaluations

Qualifications

To fill this position, you are required to have a master’s degree and must have:

• High-level practical experience, which has not been gained through academic employment with a university, or

• Employment in an academic principal position with another university (e.g. as assistant professor/researcher, associate professor/senior researcher, or professor/professor with special responsibilities).

• A part-time lecturer who is employed on the merits of his or her relevant practical experience must possess in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of the possible applications of the subject/academic discipline. This knowledge is/has been acquired through employment within the subject/academic discipline.

Other skills

• In addition to having a relevant master’s degree, emphasis is placed on your specialization and professional skills within the content of the respective courses covered by the department

• You possess good collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to a good working environment

• Proficiency in both Danish and English as teaching is conducted in both Danish and English

• It is an advantage to hold a PhD in a relevant discipline

The conditions of employment and the qualification requirements are described further in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Terms of employment

Salary and employment will be in accordance with the Cirkulære om aftale om Eksterne lektorer ved universiteter m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet. The maximum number of working hours per academic year is 500 and may vary as needed in individual semesters. Remuneration is based on the number of hours, which is determined twice a year.

When employed as a part-time lecturer you must take an introductory course on university teaching organised by CBS.

You will be assigned a researcher at the department as your professional contact person. You are expected to participate in professional events relevant to your teaching and you will also be part of the department’s network of part-time lecturers.

The recruitment process

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Further information

If you would like to know more about the position, please do not hesitate to contact Head of Department Jens Gammelgaard, jg.egb@cbs.dk

Interviews are expected to be held at the beginning of January, 2027.

WE TRANSFORM SOCIETY WITH BUSINESS

Copenhagen Business School (CBS) is an international university focused on the opportunities and challenges facing the business community and society. Through research, education and collaboration with the world around us, we work to drive positive change in society.

Our strategy, We transform society with business, guides everything we do. At CBS, researchers, lecturers and administrative employees bring different competences to the table, working together towards a shared ambition.

CBS is located in Frederiksberg, close to the centre of Copenhagen. Our campus is home to an international community of students, researchers and employees and is also open to the wider community.

CBS is working continuously on becoming a diverse and inclusive organisation, and we encourage all regardless of gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religious beliefs, LGBT+ status, cultural background etc. to apply. Reach out to us if you need assistance in the application or recruitment process, if there is something we should know, or if as a person with disability you wish to make use of your preferential access.

We transform society with business.

jobs.occupation: Two postdoc positions in agentic AI and autonomous discovery of advanced energy materials - DTU Energy
jobs.description:
Are you excited about the prospects of a career at the intersection of machine learning, materials science and autonomous robotics? Do concepts like federated self-driving laboratories (SDL), machine-learned potentials, agentic AI, FAIR workflows, and autonomous materials discovery resonate with you? If so, then these positions could be exactly what you are looking for.

At DTU Energy and the Pioneer Center CAPeX, you will contribute to developing novel machine-learning methods and AI-accelerated approaches that integrate generative models, machine-learned interatomic potentials, autonomous synthesis robotics and operando characterization with materials and device-level testing, and linking of high-throughput discovery platforms to manufacturability at scale of advanced materials for sustainable energy materials and technologies.

You will become part of a highly international and trans-disciplinary research environment in the Pioneer Center CAPeX, and our large-scale initiatives BRIGHT (sustainable polymers for, e.g., battery applications) and MaterialsCommons for Europe (e.g., hybrid computational-experimental workflows linking different SDLs).

Responsibilities for the two positions:

• The development of next-generation MLIPs and Hessian Interatomic Potentials (HIPs) for prediction of electrochemical reactions mechanisms and rates at solid-liquid and solid-polymer interfaces in batteries and catalysts, e.g., for in-loop deployment in agentic workflows bridging experimental and simulation-based modalities.

• The development experimental of SDL modules for synthesis and testing of sustainable battery and catalyst materials and interfaces, e.g., PFAS-free binders and electrolytes, and their implementation in agentic workflows for federated deployment of experiments and simulations.

Please indicate which of the positions you would potentially be interested in (you can select both).

Responsibilities:

• Report your research results in scientific publications and international conferences

• Investigate the innovation potential in your research

• Collaborate within the research group and our local, national and international networks

• Disseminate your results through public engagement

• Teach and supervise MSc and BSc students as well as research assistants

Qualifications:

• A PhD degree in materials science, chemistry, physics, computer science, or a related field

• Experience with atomic-scale simulations, robotics, or self-driving laboratories

• Experience with machine learning and/or electrochemical characterization techniques

• Experience with scientific workflow management systems

• Excellent communication and social skills for working within an interdisciplinary research team

• Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English

• Strong analytical skills and ability to work independently

Preferred qualifications but not mandatory:

• Machine learning interatomic potentials or Hessian interatomic potentials

• Polymer and/or inorganic materials synthesis

• Structural characterization methods

• High-performance computing

• Generative AI or active learning methods for materials discovery

As a formal qualification, you must hold a PhD degree (or equivalent).

We offer

DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and terms of employment

The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 2 years. The preferred starting date is 1 March 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The positions are full time, and it will be supervised by Professor Tejs Vegge.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here**.**

Further information

Further information may be obtained from Professor, Director Tejs Vegge: teve@dtu.dk

Find more information about DTU Energy at www.energy.dtu.dk/, MaterialsCommons: https://www.materialscommons.eu, BRIGHT: https://bright.dtu.dk/, and The Pioneer Center CAPeX: https://www.capex.dtu.dk

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark.

Application procedure

Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 10 January 2027 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• Application (cover letter)

• CV

• Academic Diplomas (MSc/PhD – in English)

• List of publications

• Two letters of recommendation

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

The Pioneer Center CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by the Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU) and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, Imperial College London, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization at http://www.capex.dtu.dk_._

MaterialsCommons is a large-scale European initiative funded under HORIZON-CL4-INDUSTRY-2025-01-MATERIALS-45: Materials Commons for Europe (IA). The mission is to drive forward innovation and cross-sector collaboration in materials science by establishing a federated digital infrastructure that seamlessly connects researchers from both industry and academia. We are building on strong synergies with key initiatives such as Material Digital_,_ DIADEM_,_ MaX_,_ CAPeX_, and numerous other national platforms. Furthermore, our approach is fully aligned with relevant innovation strategies, policies, and programmes across Europe, ensuring coherence, scalability, and long-term impact._

BRIGHT – The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition. The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT) is a major initiative based at DTU that aims to accelerate the development of biosolutions and strengthen the bio-based economy. BRIGHT serves as a hub for academic and industrial partners working together to unlock the potential of bioproduction. BRIGHT focuses on three main areas: Sustainable materials (Developing bio-based alternatives to fossil-derived materials), Microbial foods (Innovating food production through microbial technologies), and Microorganisms for net-zero agriculture (Creating solutions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in agriculture). The goal is to develop and scale innovative biosolutions within these areas, ultimately creating sustainable and competitive alternatives to fossil-based products and processes that can make significant contributions to reducing global greenhouse gas emissions.

The Department of Energy Conversion and Storage (DTU Energy) focuses on research and development of functional materials, components, and systems for sustainable energy technologies. The technologies include fuel cells, electrolysis, power-to-x, batteries, and carbon capture. The research is based on strong competences on electrochemistry, atomic scale and multi-physics modelling, autonomous materials discovery, materials processing, and structural analyses. We also focus on educating engineering students at all levels, ranging from BSc, MSc, PhD to lifelong learning students. We have about 300 dedicated employees. Read more about us at www.energy.dtu.dk_._

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829

DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Manager, Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**

Manager, Strategy & Execution

Posting Start Date: 10/26/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Manager, Strategy & Execution

**

• Location: Copenhagen / Lisbon

• Work model: Hybrid / Full time

• Contract type / duration: Permanent

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

• Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days

• Developing a methodology to define future market roles

• Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency

• Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period

jobs.occupation: Associate Director, Quality Assurance – Drug Product & Device
jobs.description:
About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

Getting a promising treatment into a clinical trial takes more than good science. Patients need medicines and delivery devices they can rely on, made to the right standards and available when needed.

As Associate Director, QA Drug Product & Device, you'll own quality oversight of our drug product manufacturing partners and combination product development. You'll work closely with CMC, Manufacturing and device development colleagues to resolve quality risks, keep clinical supplies moving and build the quality framework Hemab needs as its pipeline advances.

What you'll do

• Ensure QA oversight of selected drug product CDMOs and fill-finish activities in collaboration with the CMC and Manufacturing team

• Ensure QA oversight of design controls and risk management for combination products, including review and approval of design control deliverables, in line with 21 CFR Part 4 and EU MDR Article 117

• QA review and approval of master and executed batch records, specifications, protocols and reports

• Oversee and manage drug product deviations, CAPAs and change controls

• Ensure batch documentation is complete and release-ready, and support the Qualified Person in the certification and release of drug product and combination product batches

• Create and review quality agreements with drug product CDMOs and suppliers

• Advise and support the CMC and Manufacturing team as quality lead for selected programs

• Participate in building and improving fit-for-purpose quality systems and processes as Hemab grows, and contribute to projects across Quality and the wider organization

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Hands-on QA experience with combination products or drug-device products, including design controls and ISO 14971 risk management

• Experience overseeing drug product CDMOs, ideally aseptic fill-finish, including audits and quality agreements

• Working knowledge of EU GMP (including Annex 1), 21 CFR Parts 210/211 and 600-610, and 21 CFR Part 4 and ISO 13485.

• A collaborative, cross-functional working style, partnering closely with CMC & Manufacturing, device development, supply chain and regulatory colleagues

• Good communication skills. English is our company language, so you are comfortable writing and speaking it professionally

• A solution-oriented and hands-on way of working, comfortable taking ownership and shaping processes as the organization evolves.

Nice to have Eligibility, or a realistic path, to act as an EU Qualified Person

• Experience with prefilled syringes, autoinjectors or other injectable delivery systems

• Danish language skills

What to expect, honestly

You'll be accountable for quality, but much of the manufacturing happens outside Hemab. That means working through CDMOs, sometimes with incomplete information, competing timelines and decisions that cannot wait. You'll need to know when to challenge, when to escalate and when there's enough evidence to move forward.

Drug product manufacturing and device development don't always move at the same pace. A late deviation, an unresolved design control issue or missing batch documentation can affect clinical supply. You'll need to get close to the detail, work directly with partners and find a compliant way forward.

Some of our quality frameworks are still being built. You'll help establish them while managing today's work. If you prefer established systems and clearly separated responsibilities, this may be frustrating. If you enjoy building sensible ways of working that protect patients without slowing good decisions, there's room to make a real difference.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.
